primary_task: Set up or migrate a Next.js app to vinext on Cloudflare Workers by installing and following vinext's upstream skills.

requirements.name: registry.npmjs.org
requirements.check: npm view skills version ; npm view create-vinext-app version ; npm view vinext version

requirements.name: upstream-skills-source
requirements.evidence: install them: npx skills add cloudflare/vinext ... If installation is unavailable, read the linked upstream SKILL.md directly

requirements.name: wrangler
requirements.evidence: Development and deployment: follow the Workers integration docs

notes: Ambiguous: description says 'Build, migrate, and deploy'. Deployment is one of several entry cases (new project / migrate / deploy), so treated as conditional; if a deploy is requested it is BLOCKED (no Cloudflare token, api.cloudflare.com refused). github.com HTTPS web pages to non-session repos return 403 from the proxy, but git clone/ls-remote of public repos works.
